meta.title: Fix static member exports to not instantiate declaring type
meta.body_summary: Prevent unnecessary instantiation of declaring class when accessing static member exports in MEF by checking IsStatic before creating part lifecycle trackers, and bypass instantiation for static members.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot fixed MEF static member instantiation; multiple review rounds resolved config regressions and MEFv2 engine compatibility; PR open after ~12h with iterative fixes.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 172 changed lines across 5 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It targets a specific MEF inefficiency and aligns with a small-step performance PR, which typically suffers low merge friction if correctness is ensured; currently open after multiple review rounds addressing SDK version, nuget source, MEF engine compatibility.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer AArnott requested reverts to global.json and nuget.config, advised running tests against all MEF engines (V1Compat, V2Compat) with MEFv2 attributes, then flagged that MEFv2 does not support exporting fields/methods, requiring removal of those attributes; these concerns revolve around correctness and compatibility.
review_details.performance_claim: Avoid unnecessary instantiation of declaring class for static member exports, reducing performance overhead and side effects.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Copilot made correct core logic changes but initially introduced unrelated build config changes (SDK version, nuget source) that were incorrect for the repository; subsequent rounds revealed lack of understanding of MEF engine capabilities (MEFv2 doesn't support field/method exports). This shows boundary in navigating existing project-specific configuration and nuanced engine version constraints.

detection_detail.code_reading: AArnott identified unnecessary config changes and MEF engine capability mismatches during review.
detection_detail.ci_auto: Azure Pipelines triggered multiple times via /azp run to validate changes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR provides unit tests verifying that static fields/properties/methods do not trigger constructor, but no before/after timing evidence.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: Initial commit inadvertently modified global.json and nuget.config, which were reverted; MEFv2 engine compatibility was iteratively refined over several commits.

core_change_summary.description: Modified ExportProvider.CreateExport() and RuntimeExportProvider.GetExportedValue() to check MemberRef.IsStatic() before creating part lifecycle trackers; for static members, bypass instantiation and call GetValueFromMember with null instance. Added unit tests for various static export scenarios.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: global.json and nuget.config were transiently modified and then reverted; final test file has many iterative changes.
